topic: start a car with a dead battery
core_question: How do I get my car started when the battery is completely dead? (secondary: How do I take a screenshot on my Windows computer?)
answer_summary: Connect jumper cables from a working vehicle's battery to the dead one (positive to positive, negative to a grounded metal point), then start the working car and try starting yours.; after the topic shift: Press Windows+Shift+S to open the snipping tool and select an area, or press Print Screen to capture the whole screen to the clipboard.
persona: friendly but persistent; using casual slang
